evidence_kind: Observation receipt with original per-test raw logs; no test rerun was performed to package this archive
individual_wall_times: not recorded by the original run; not inferred from filesystem timestamps

tests.name: 应该可以输出正确的计算结果
tests.scope: 64轮、8路点积；bias初始化、结果保持、done回空闲

tests.name: 应该能以合理的时序发送预处理信号
tests.scope: INIT预取k=0；RUN预取k+1；末轮关闭权重读使能

tests.name: 应该能正确执行 8 路并行乘累加
tests.scope: 8 PE一次并行MAC及关闭enable后的结果保持

tests.name: 应自动遍历两行两组并正确输出结果
keeps every bank and group distinct through masked writes and task refresh
tests.scope: 256项全写；256次固定种子随机字节掩码写；256项第二任务刷新；全32组×8路校验及signed40边界

tests.name: 应正确从存储器读取数据，完成两组 8 路点积
tests.scope: group0/1、正负权重、16个结果；每组启动至done观察66周期

tests.name: 应正确计算跨 SRAM 边界的两个 group
selects legacy or per-group signed40 biases without changing MAC results
tests.scope: 2任务×2bias模式×4组（0/15/16/31）=16组、128结果；非零MAC及signed40极值

tests.name: 能否正常完成读写操作
tests.scope: 8 bank独立写入后同地址并行读与rvalid

tests.name: 应该可以按照规定的时序读出和写入
tests.scope: 单地址负数同步读写、rvalid失效

tests.name: 应该正确完成写入、连续读取和跨 SRAM 边界访问
应自动计算 99x256 个输出并与参考结果一致
tests.scope: 99行×32组×8路=25,344个结果；完整W/X装载及独立BigInt参考结果

limitations: The ScalaTest aggregate stdout was not originally redirected to a file; its summary is labeled as an observation receipt.
Per-test simulation-log.txt files are empty when the simulator emitted no console text; their exact empty bytes and SHA256 are preserved.
Absolute paths inside raw compiler/protocol logs are retained as evidence; tar entry names are relative and contain no parent traversal.
This local Chisel/Icarus evidence does not establish server VCS performance or physical PPA.
